Subject: Approval Request: Six-Week Invoice Handling Pilot

Hi Morgan,

I’m proposing a six-week pilot to assess invoice handling for a fixed fee of $30,000. The pilot will evaluate the client’s goal of shortening handling time by 20%. Since no baseline or measured savings currently exists, the pilot will provide an opportunity to assess performance against that target.

Production rollout is excluded from the pilot scope. Access to client data—and therefore the pilot—will remain subject to security clearance. No start date has been approved.

Please confirm your approval of the six-week pilot scope and $30,000 fixed fee, subject to security clearance. Once approved, we can move the discussion forward.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
